item.title: Silver Springs datacenter construction update
item.description: Microsoft is beginning early construction work at its datacenter site in Silver Springs, Nevada.
item.content:encoded:
Silver Springs datacenter construction update

Microsoft is beginning early construction work at its datacenter site in Silver Springs, Nevada. We are committed to keeping the community informed as work progresses and to reducing construction-related impacts where possible.

Why datacenters are needed

Datacenters provide the physical infrastructure that supports the technology people use every day.
